title: What's the feeling of this?
author: Remote-History-6458
selftext: I'm working on a walkout scene pre match for my soccer game, how the vibe? I need to remove the referee during this cause it's just in the way but overall I like it maybe adding some waving animation from some player as they walk out?

comments.author: maxneuds
comments.body:
Everything and the vibe look horrible and then you don't even show the interesting part.

Looks like HD 2.5D style which is fine I guess. These default Tripo3D style chibi models look soulless and the animations are bad. Wouldn't make me want to touch it.

If gameplay has this artstyle paired with some over the top Captain Tsubasa effects that could be interesting and might catch attention to play, but definitely not your shown scene.

comments.author: Azilen
comments.body:
To be honest, no one watches these animations before the matches, go focus on the match.  
But my take on this:  
Why are they all mad? Make them have a more neutral expression on the walkout, it's a presentation, they don't have to be that serious and focused.  
I'm ok with these "cute" anime 3d characters, but when you make one bald with a goatee it gets really strange.
